subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run timeout surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: The request is compatibility-sensitive because it adds a public config/default surface in provider routing and fallback behavior, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with documented precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline the new key and improve docs around provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Keep generation timeout out of scope and route thinking stalls or repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with documented precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the config/product choice on this issue and has adjacent config-schema history.
